bullets: Nightfall heals 6% of ability damage to heroes, and Orbital Sanction's beam hits every 0.25s for up to 9s, so the ultimate fed steady healing.
Savage Strikes heals for its on-hit damage, which grows 100% per stack up to 3 times while he keeps hitting heroes, and the rifle triggers it every shot.
61 ability haste brought Orbital Sanction back in about 68.3s, and Spear Of Desolation added 10% damage for 6s after each cast.
Molotov, Oil Spill and Inferno each set off Megacosm and Combustion, and Oil Spill and Inferno hit areas, so one cast triggered both items on several heroes.
Hold This! made Molotov permanently stronger each time it hit a hero, and 48 ability haste brought it back every 5.4s, so the bonus kept growing.
Aion's mana regen from every cast kept the mana bar full, and Runic Focus turns a fuller mana bar into more magical power for every spell.
Make Way's armor shred and Knell's Rust stacks stripped armor together, and keeping Rust at full stacks switched on Fracture's extra damage against that target.
Imperial Soul made Stone Forged Soul hit 12% harder in a 20% larger area, and its stasis heal let him land it from inside the enemy team.
Draconum stacked up his healing while he kept hitting heroes, and Tainted Guard cut healing on anyone basic attacking him, so trades leaned his way.
